_about: SA V2 cost-row race (CONTRACT §15). Create the four items (race/make_item_requests.py prints the ITEM_SAVE calls), then python3 race/seed_plan.py --fill-ids writes race/config.json with their ids (+ batch_id after seed step 1); then python3 race/seed_plan.py --check. Everything here is DEV; tenant 496474 was offered for our tests by GD Edit & Picking V2 (announce first).
_auth: runas = fire.mjs spawns scratchpad/gdc/tools/runas.mjs with the identity below (a real admin@496474; the runner mints a 15-min token per call, nothing stored); cli = the sudu-lowcode dev-write session (runwf.mjs pattern), tenant 000000 only

bins._bins: L1 / L2 of Testing Plant 1 (bin_location, active). A works in bin1, B in bin2: different ITEM| lock keys, so the engine locks never meet - only the cost rows (material + plant) are shared

_uom: PCS (tenant 496474) - the base UOM of every test item; movements pass it as material_uom

fifo_batch.name: SA race FIFO batch - test only

filler.name: SA race filler (Fixed Cost) - test only
filler._filler: R0's large op B: ADD 1 / SUBTRACT 1 pairs in bin1 - Fixed Cost touches no cost row, so B's cost writes are only the shared material's

R0.about: silent interleaving (eb): B = large SA-shaped op (filler pairs + 1 SUBTRACT of the shared FIFO item in bin2), A = 1 SUBTRACT of it in bin1 fired after B's cost read

scenarios._batch: fire.mjs --batch runs R1 / R3 on materials.fifo_batch (batch_id) instead: the batch-scoped FIFO path

op_key: SACRACE|<run>|<A|B>  (engine guard: 1-32 of A-Z a-z 0-9 | : . _ -; run ids are R<n>-<nn>[b], e.g. SACRACE|R0-07|B)
trx_no: SACRACE|<run>  (inventory_movement.trx_no of the race ops; transaction_type SA)
